Subject: MAP Kickoff — AWS Marketplace ops + Partner Contacts

Hi Jordan, Sanjay, Taylor —

Thanks for carving out time this week. As discussed during last week's briefing, we'd like to formalize a short mutual action plan (MAP) that covers: the evaluation checklist Acme needs, the artifacts AWS Marketplace requires for listing, and the partner ops steps CloudBridge will own. The goal: align on responsibilities and a close target so procurement at Acme has a single timeline to work against.

Proposed 8-week cadence (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff, share draft MAP and initial SOC2 artifacts
- Week 1–2: Technical evaluation by Acme (PoC access, SSO, data residency notes)
- Week 3: Marketplace listing prep (pricing SKU, EULA, listing metadata) – AWS & CloudBridge to sync
- Week 4–5: Contract & procurement (paper review, redlines)
- Week 6: Final verification and signoff; target carry-over to listing schedule

Key asks today:
1) Jordan — confirm internal evaluation stakeholders and target completion date for the technical run (we penciled Aug 11).
2) Sanjay/Taylor — who owns the AWS listing inventory (SKU creation) and what files you need from our side?
3) Lauren/Diego (Redwood) — assign owners for PoC credentials and SOC2 evidence packaging.

I've attached a draft MAP workbook and a short SOC2 briefing to speed reviews. I'll update the workbook after we lock roles.

If this proposed schedule looks reasonable, I'll send a follow-up that converts tasks into a shared checklist (we can use the Google folder linked below).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Appreciate the clear draft, Alex. Quick answers from CloudBridge's side:
- I'll be the primary for CloudBridge ops (we'll surface any sub-owners but loop me for all listing approvals).
- For AWS SKU creation, we need the final pricing table (per-usage and committed tiers), product description, and the SAML metadata for any SSO links.
- We can take point on coordinating the marketplace submission windows with AWS.

We'll also open a shared Jira board for tracking the MAP tasks; I'll post the board link by EOD.

Sanjay
